caption: The video captures a brown tabby cat standing at a faucet beneath a thin, continuous stream of falling water. The curved metal spout and patterned beige tile wall remain fixed in the frame, while the cat occupies the right side with its shoulder, front legs, and head held close to the stream. Throughout the scene, the water keeps flowing straight downward, its surface shimmering as the stream passes in front of the cat's face. The cat's head stays in a sideways, profile-like orientation under the faucet curve, tilting only slightly as it works closer to the water rather than turning to face the viewer. As it shifts, the whiskers spread near the falling column and the muzzle settles progressively closer to the stream. The cat's body stays largely in place, showing only small adjustments rather than stepping away or moving across the frame. Its wide yellow eyes keep facing forward toward the camera, and its face stays positioned to meet the water. The cat remains in this near-stream pose while the faucet and falling water continue unchanged.
